import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;
    static class Matrix {
        int h, w;
        long[] a;
        public Matrix(int n) {
            this.h = n; this.w = n;
            this.a = new long[n*n];
        }
        public Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.h = n; this.w = m;
            this.a = new long[n*m];
        }
        public Matrix(int n, int m, long[] a_) {
            this.h = n; this.w = m; this.a = a_;
        }
        public long get(int r,int c) {
            return a[r*w + c];
        }
        public void set(int r,int c,long val) {
            a[r*w + c] = val;
        }
        public Matrix addInPlace(Matrix m) {
            for (int i=0; i<h*w; i++) {
                a[i] += m.a[i];
            }
            return this;
        }
        public Matrix subtractInPlace(Matrix m) {
            for (int i=0; i<h*w; i++) {
                a[i] -= m.a[i];
            }
            return this;
        }
        public Matrix multiplyInPlace(Matrix m) {
            assert(this.w == m.h);
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(this.h, m.w);
            for(int i=0; i<h; i++) {
                for(int j=0; j<m.w; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for(int k=0; k<w; k++) {
                        sum += get(i,k)*m.get(k,j) % mod;
                    }
                    ret.set(i,j,sum%mod);
                }
            }
            this.h = ret.h;
            this.w = ret.w;
            this.a = ret.a;
            return this;
        }
        public static Matrix add(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            return new Matrix(a.h, a.w, a.a.clone()).addInPlace(b);
        }
        public static Matrix subtract(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            return new Matrix(a.h, a.w, a.a.clone()).subtractInPlace(b);
        }
        public static Matrix multiply(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            return new Matrix(a.h,b.w).multiplyInPlace(b).multiplyInPlace(a);
        }
        public static Matrix unit(int n) {
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(n);
            for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                ret.set(i,i,1);
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }
    static Matrix pow(Matrix a, int n) {
        assert(a.h == a.w);
        Matrix ret = Matrix.unit(a.h);
        while(n > 0) {
            if((n & 1) == 1) ret.multiplyInPlace(a);
            a.multiplyInPlace(a);
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }
    
    static Matrix[] a = new Matrix[65];
    
    static Matrix calc(int i, int k) {
        return pow(a[i + k], k - i).multiply(pow(a[i], i));
    }
    
    static long solve(long n, long k) {
        long cnt = 0;
        long tmp = n;
        while(tmp > 0) {
            tmp /= k;
            cnt++;
        }
        long[] b = new long[(int)(cnt+5)];
        long[] c = new long[(int)(cnt+5)];
        long[] d = new long[(int)(k+1)];
        // Initialize matrices instead of long array
        // Using Matrix for b and c
        Matrix[] bMatrices = new Matrix[(int)(cnt+5)];
        Matrix[] cMatrices = new Matrix[(int)(cnt+5)];
        bMatrices[0] = a[(int)(k - 1)];
        cMatrices[0] = pow(bMatrices[0], (int)(k - 1));
        bMatrices[1] = calc((int)(k -1), (int)k);
        cMatrices[1] = pow(bMatrices[1], (int)(k - 1));
        Matrix s = Matrix.unit(2*(int)k +1);
        for (int j=2; j<=cnt+1; j++) {
            int index = (int)(k - j%k);
            bMatrices[j] = calc(index, (int)k);
            s.multiplyInPlace(cMatrices[j-1]);
            bMatrices[j].multiplyInPlace(s);
            cMatrices[j] = pow(bMatrices[j], (int)(k - 1));
        }
        int idx = 1;
        int rem = (int)(n % k);
        n -= rem;
        long tmpN = n;
        int q = 0;
        if (tmpN > 0) {
            while (tmpN % k == 0) {
                q++;
                tmpN /= k;
            }
        }
        q = (int)((k - q % k) % k);
        Matrix ans = Matrix.unit((int)(2*k + 1));
        ans = pow(a[q], rem).multiply(pow(a[q + k], Math.max(rem - q, 0)));
        n /= k;
        if (n == 0) {
            return (ans.get(2*(int)k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % mod;
        }
        n -= 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            int t = (int)(n % k);
            if (t != 0) {
                ans.multiplyInPlace(pow(bMatrices[idx], t));
            }
            n /= k;
            ++idx;
        }
        ans.multiplyInPlace(bMatrices[1]);
        long result = (ans.get(2*(int)k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % mod;
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        for (int i=0; i<=2*(int)k+1; i++) {
            a[i] = new Matrix(2*(int)k+1, 2*(int)k+1);
            for (int j=0; j<i; j++) {
                a[i].set(0,j,1);
            }
            for (int j=0; j<2*(int)k-1; j++) {
                a[i].set(j+1,j,1);
            }
            a[i].set(2*(int)k, 0, 1);
            a[i].set(2*(int)k, 2*(int)k, 1);
        }
        System.out.println(solve(n, k));
        sc.close();
    }
}
